config.title: Notification Context

intro.title: Notification Context
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple notification system using Angular's context and dependency injection. You will learn how to create a service that manages notification messages and a component that displays them. The core concept is using Angular's dependency injection to share state across components. You'll work with services, components, and TypeScript to implement this feature. This will help you understand how to manage and display dynamic data in an Angular application.
intro.usecase: Notification contexts are essential in modern web applications where users need real-time feedback about system events. In e-commerce platforms, they display order confirmations, shipping updates, and cart alerts without disrupting the shopping flow. Social media apps use them to show new messages, friend requests, and post interactions in a centralized notification panel. Dashboard applications implement notification contexts to alert users about data updates, system errors, or scheduled maintenance. This pattern allows developers to manage notification state globally while keeping UI components decoupled and reusable.

objectives: Construct a notification context service to manage notification state across components.
Initialize notification state with default values for messages and visibility.
Implement methods to add and remove notifications from the context.
Configure a component to inject and consume the notification context.
Bind notification data from the context to the component's template.
Control notification display by updating context state from user interactions.
Integrate the notification context into multiple components to share state.
